title: Gateway usage at a glance
summary: Aggregate TritonAI LLM Gateway activity shows the scale of shared model access across UC San Diego.
source: TritonAI Statistics runs 20260810T112319-0700-27a039 (January-July) and 20260902T152700-0700-e87f94 (August), raw gateway usage exports and reviewed route classification with the September 2 hosting-audit correction; Dominic Feliton September export brett-sep-26.zip, recharge-september-final-2026-v4, shared in TritonAI Brain Trust on October 5, 2026; full raw gateway activity and reviewed Stage 1 hosting classification; Dominic Feliton October export raw_data_oct.zip (complete-usage-october-2026-complete-capture-v3), shared with Brett Pollak in Teams on November 2, 2026; full raw gateway activity and Stage 1 hosting classification

metrics.label: tokens processed
metrics.definition: Total input and output tokens recorded by the gateway during the measurement period.

metrics.label: API requests
metrics.definition: Gateway request records during the measurement period, including successful and failed requests.

metrics.label: self-hosted and internal routes
metrics.definition: Share of recorded tokens not classified as commercial cloud, including internal TritonAI routes.

metrics.label: tokens in October
metrics.definition: Total token volume recorded in the latest complete month.

monthly.label: January
monthly.note: Usage was driven primarily by embedding and automated background-processing workloads, establishing the baseline for the reporting period.

monthly.label: February
monthly.note: Usage increased as application, widget, and shared API activity expanded across the platform.

monthly.label: March
monthly.note: Usage moderated as widget and automated processing activity declined, partially offset by growth through newer model routes.

monthly.label: April
monthly.note: Usage rebounded with increased embedding, background-processing, and application activity.

monthly.label: May
monthly.note: Overall usage remained relatively steady while workloads shifted toward newer self-hosted and cloud model routes.

monthly.label: June
monthly.note: June reached 73.2 billion tokens, driven by broad growth across production applications, embeddings, and automated services.

monthly.label: July
monthly.note: Usage remained elevated but declined from June as application requests, embeddings, and background processing slowed. Growth through newer model routes offset part of the reduction. Lower summer instructional activity accounted for approximately 0.8B tokens, or 12.7% of the decline, so most of the reduction came from application and platform workloads.

monthly.label: August
monthly.note: August reached the highest monthly volume of the year to date at 78.9 billion tokens, up 17.6% from July. Cloud usage increased to 14.3 billion tokens, while self-hosted and internal routes accounted for 64.5 billion tokens.

monthly.label: September
monthly.note: September recorded 71.7 billion tokens, down 9.0% from August. Self-hosted and internal routes accounted for 55.7 billion tokens, while cloud usage increased to 16.0 billion tokens. The export records the change in volume but does not establish its cause.

monthly.label: October
monthly.note: October recorded 71.3 billion tokens, about level with September (down 0.6%). Self-hosted and internal routes rose 5.9% to 59.0 billion tokens, while cloud usage fell 23.1% to 12.3 billion tokens. The export records the change in volume but does not establish its cause.

notes: January through July retains the reviewed V3 model-route classification. August uses the reviewed classification with the September 2 hosting-audit correction, moving 8,340,260 tokens from self-hosted to cloud. Self-hosted and internal includes all remaining recorded tokens, including internal TritonAI routes. September and October use the export’s Stage 1 hosting classification. Its 143 unclassified tokens, and October's 366, remain in the non-cloud remainder under this series’ existing definition of self-hosted and internal.
The monthly series reconciles to 598,326,063,857 tokens and 166,831,485 request records for January through October 2026.

Token totals use the gateway's recorded input plus output tokens. August through October cache-read and cache-creation fields are not added separately. The earlier January-July export did not expose those fields, so an upstream token-definition change cannot be completely ruled out.
August includes all 31 days and 18,971,745 request records. Daily token and request totals reconcile exactly between the supplied normalized export and raw gateway response.

September includes all 30 days and 13,120,410 request records, including successful and failed requests. Recorded input tokens (70,210,137,458) plus output tokens (1,521,485,910) equal 71,731,623,368 total tokens. Daily totals reconcile exactly between the normalized export and raw gateway response; recharge-filtered totals are not used.

October includes all 31 days and 9,801,361 request records, including successful and failed requests. Recorded input tokens (70,266,344,421) plus output tokens (1,032,410,593) equal 71,298,755,014 total tokens. Daily totals reconcile exactly between the complete paginated usage capture, its control total, and the Stage 1 hosting partition; recharge-filtered totals are not used.
monthlyDriversIntro: Month-to-month changes reflect the mix of campus applications, automated services, model routing, and instructional activity using the TritonAI Gateway.
